content.text:
If you’re in the **U.S.**, the safest current Domino’s discounts are usually the **official local deals** rather than random voucher-code sites:

- **Mix & Match:** choose any 2+ items for **$6.99 each** — prices may be higher by location.
- **Weeklong Carryout:** carryout pizzas from **$7.99 each**.
- **Parmesan Stuffed Crust promo:** **$10.99 each** when ordering 2+ qualifying pizzas; listed as running **April 7–June 14, 2026** at participating stores. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/deals?utm_source=openai))

You can check your store’s official coupons by going to Domino’s **Deals / Local Deals** page; availability varies by store. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/deals?utm_source=openai))

Third-party sites currently list codes like **“PremiumSeries”** for up to **35% off select items**, but these are less reliable and may only work at certain stores/items. ([simplycodes.com](https://simplycodes.com/store/dominos.com?utm_source=openai))

Tip: try the **official deal tab first**, then test any promo code at checkout before paying.
